kit: Heavy Pulse Rifle: hitscan 19 damage (5.7 at 50 m, falloff from 30 m), 9 rounds/s, 30 ammo, headshot x2, no spread (spread was replaced by vertical recoil in 2020), ~0.1 deg of climb per shot (~0.9 deg/s of pull-down while firing); Helix Rockets 50 m/s; Sprint +50%; Tactical Visor; 250 HP
method: HeroLab (PsyLab generalised): trained-inverse feedforward + 120 ms visual feedback, signal-dependent motor noise 2-12 Hz + tremor, projectile lead / recoil pull-down / descending aim / target switching as a ballistic minimum-jerk throw (90 ms + 0.45 ms/deg; re-acquire at the hero's tempo) with +-14% log tempo variability, then one corrective submovement (seen 50 ms after landing, 150 ms long, after the 120 ms visual delay), scored from the landing on per scenario, shipping curve math at 360 Hz, RawAccel exact angle snap, integer counts with remainder, the game's Master filter simulated; error vs intended path in target radii; each engagement scored relative to the best legal curve in that engagement, excess scaled by frequency
rule: legal (onset <= 3 ms, micro 90-130%, 180 <= 70 mm at 150 ms, peak hand <= 600 mm/s, not a reference) -> pool = 8 best relative score + 4 most consistent within 10% -> snap x Y/X x filter, best variant per curve -> rescored under 5 hand models -> regret within 5% of the most robust curve -> most consistent re-acquire, then weighted error
